name: repo-alias
about: Phase 6b: /loop add names a repo by an alias from loopd's repos file ("node app", "mobile") only as a leading [x] or x:, or a trailing "in x"; the words leave the title and the item gets the repo, so triage does not route it. An alias in the middle of the sentence is just a word: no repo, triage routes it.
